newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian soldiers kill four separatists in Kashmir.
newsitem.headline: Indian soldiers kill four separatists in Kashmir.

text.p: Four separatist guerrillas were killed on Saturday in a six-hour gunbattle with Indian security forces in the troubled Jammu and Kashmir state, a defence spokesman said.
The incident happened in Langate village in Kupwara district, near the Pakistan border 85 km (53 miles) north of Srinagar, the summer capital of Jammu and Kashmir.
Rashtriya Rifles is a wing of the Indian army, fighting a seven-year-old separatist rebellion in the Himalayan state.

In another incident, unidentified gunmen opened fire on a scooter-taxi at a crowded market-place in Nowhatta, a downtown locality in Srinagar, police said. Two people were killed and one seriously injured in the shootout.

Over a dozen militant groups are fighting New Delhi's rule in Jammu and Kashmir, India's only Moslem majority state. Police and hospital sources say more than 20,000 people have been killed in the rebellion that broke out in 1990.
